extraction_notes: 本 batch 1 deck (人才述职型) 共 8 section, 抽出 8 patterns: 复用 previous_batches 中 opening_cover_plus_progress_highlighted_toc 与 closing_minimal_thanks_with_speaker_signature 2 条; 新增 6 条 pattern (self_intro_with_toc_transition_dual_timeline / motivation_analogy_codesign_demand_supply_gap / framework_codesign_grand_narrative_to_layered_scientific_problem / result_three_work_overview_drilldown_awards_endorsement / case_study_academic_to_industry_closed_loop_with_venture_history / appendix_single_page_industrial_architecture_showcase). new_archetype: historical_revolution_analogy_matrix — 以历次技术革命(蒸汽机等)与当代智能革命并列的横向对照矩阵; new_archetype: algorithm_hardware_dual_panel_codesign — 左右双面板(算法软件/硬件载体)+中央循环协同箭头; new_archetype: hardware_slowdown_moore_law_curve — 摩尔定律时间线+性能增速曲线论证硬件放缓; new_archetype: codesign_grand_narrative_scaling_law — Scaling Law+软硬协同=优化求解+三层收益放大总纲; new_archetype: sparse_mechanism_speedup_intro — 神经网络剪枝+稀疏矩阵乘法+加速倍数原理页; new_archetype: case_study_three_layer_optimization — 图计算案例三层堆叠优化框; new_archetype: opensource_library_benchmark_validation — 自研库跨代际+算子+应用三档 benchmark 面板; new_archetype: scientific_problem_three_layer_taxonomy — 稀疏非结构化vs硬件结构化科学问题算子/应用/模型三层拆解; new_archetype: three_work_parallel_overview — 顶部主论断+三栏并列成果+加速区间总览页; new_archetype: work_layered_drilldown — 左侧①②③分层框架图+右侧红蓝论断+方法结果面板; new_archetype: aggregated_gain_industrial_metrics — 左块等效算力提升柱图+右块产业化指标 TOP1 汇总; new_archetype: best_paper_awards_montage — 顶部蓝框主论断+多卡片奖项列举获奖清单; new_archetype: expert_endorsement_trio_quotes — 3列专家评价卡片(姓名/头衔/会议引用); new_archetype: effective_compute_formula_expansion — 上下两层公式蓝框+下钻大箭头扩展有效算力公式; new_archetype: idea_to_industry_pipeline_ecosystem — IDEA→PAPER→DEMO→PRODUCT→INDUSTRY 五段流水线+人才生态支撑; new_archetype: venture_history_timeline — 水平时间轴+上下交错事件标注创业史; new_archetype: current_compute_gap_bubble_and_chip_compare — 模型算力气泡图+芯片演进+国产vs国外制程对比; new_archetype: layered_solution_architecture_overview — 左侧四层竖排坐标+右侧多层模块框矩阵; new_archetype: layered_solution_technical_advantages — 三层MaaS/PaaS/IaaS横条+四优势量化卡片; new_archetype: venture_capital_backing_wall — 投资机构 logo 网格墙+融资金额强调; new_archetype: academic_industry_closed_loop_summary — 学术-产业循环闭环框+学术成效清单; new_archetype: self_intro_research_plus_dual_timeline (existing 词表已有,复用); new_archetype: single_page_industrial_architecture_with_bullets — 左侧文字标签+右侧自底向上分层算力架构+顶部应用场景收束页. 因 batch 仅 1 deck 且属特殊人才述职型 (报告类型=简历), 多数新 pattern 的 source_count=1 且 confidence=low, 待后续 batch 若出现同类述职型 deck 可提升 confidence.
